factors.label: Predicted winning margin
factors.detail: Our pre-game model's point estimate on current, complete rosters.

factors.label: Likely margin range (80%)
factors.detail: Calibrated from how far our past margin calls actually missed.

factors.label: Wider margin range (90%)
factors.detail: The outer band — a single game's margin swings a lot.

factors.label: Combined total (points)
factors.detail: Our total-points projection with its empirical range.

factors.label: Home win chance
factors.detail: Recalibrated win probability for the home side.

steps.label: Neutral-court strength edge
steps.detail: On a neutral floor we make IND the better side of this matchup by 9.19 points over TOR, before anything about tonight is applied.

sub.label: Roster talent
sub.detail: Minutes-weighted strength of who is actually available to play.

sub.label: Season results form
sub.detail: How each side has actually performed, rated strictly before this game.

steps.label: Home court
steps.detail: The home edge our model carries league-wide. It is the same for every team; we do not claim a venue-specific edge we have not measured.

steps.label: Calibration to results
steps.detail: A standing correction for the model's average miss against actual finals, re-fit when the margin model is rebuilt.

steps.label: Projected margin
steps.detail: The three lines above, added. This is the published number — nothing is applied after this point.

why.omitted: Rest, travel, pace and matchup carry no separate weight in this margin — they are not part of the published number. Availability enters only inside roster talent and cannot be split out of it.

note: Every figure is read from a core pipeline table — the deep page renders, it never computes.
